text:
alex: Quick heads-up — final gating window opens in 45m. Please stop non-essential merges and push any urgent cherry-picks now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: Quick Q — is the branch cut still 'release/v1.5' or did that move?
sam: release/v1.5 is locked to RC binaries. Only security or regression fixes allowed.
chris: I have a small docs-only change that touched version stamp. Should that wait?
maya: docs-only that doesn't change binary artifacts can wait for post-cut if CI green, but ping me if you want a fast-track.
az: @alex pasted the failing CI logs on #eng-ci — looks unrelated to my changelist.
alex: thanks @az. If it's unrelated we shouldn't block cutoff, but don't merge until green.
release-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: automatic merge queue will pause at cutoff. See /release-policies for exceptions.
sam: Exception ask: need to late-merge a hotfix for the embeddings runtime where NPE happens on long prompts. PR #6123.
chris: @sam can you paste the `git cherry-pick` steps you're proposing?
sam: Sure:
```
# from release/v1.5
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix/emb-npe origin/release/v1.5
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
# run full unit + runtime smoke
```
chris: Runbook: add a test that reproduces NPE and a smoke run on a dedicated GPU pool before asking for exception.
maya: Can we get an owner to approve the test and validate before merge? @oz can you?
azor is Oz? wait
oz: I'm on it, will validate smoke on the dedicated pool in ~20m.
ci-bot: CI status for PR #6123: unit ✅, integration ⏳, perf smoke queued.
alex: High-level: exceptions allowed only if regression or security and validated by oncall. Keep the PR description explicit and link the failing prod trace.
sam: linked trace: https://sentry.prod/issue/RT-9482 — reproduced locally.
maya: If oz validates and CI green, I'll sign off the exception. Otherwise we hold until post-freeze.
ochris: small note — update changelog entry under "Unreleased" with the exact PR link; we'll squash into release notes.
alex: final reminder: lock version stamps after cutoff. The release manager will do the final stamp at T+2h.
release-bot: Notice: Code freeze at 2177778000 UTC. Auto-tags will be applied to release/v1.5 branch.
maya: thanks everyone. If you need an emergency auto-merge, put "freeze-exception" in the PR title and @maya + @alex reactions.
sam: thanks — will wait for oz validation and then request exception. :thumbsup:
oz: validated smoke on dedicated pool, perf within expected delta. CI green.
ci-bot: PR #6123 merge queue: staged. Awaiting manual exception approval.
maya: Approved — adding :white_check_mark: Rebase and merge at will. Remember to run the final post-merge binary sanity check.
alex: Merged. Post-merge check passed. Tagging for RC. Thanks team. :party-parrot:
